interpretation: Useful primary base and uniform advantage remains unresolved under both interval methods; pooled and donor exclude useful advantage under both. All primary intervals include zero. Residual donor advantage is excluded under both methods; pooled remains unresolved under both and uniform remains unresolved only under crossed resampling. All residual intervals include zero. Raw sums retain base uncertainty under both methods and exclude pooled and donor advantage under both. All raw model-rival intervals include zero; raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods.
